rules.message: The method is a deprecated no-op.
rules.advice: To keep column widths or row heights across page loads, store the columnWidths and rowHeights values yourself, for example in localStorage, and pass them back as settings when the grid initializes.

rules.message: Core lost the undo methods and the undoRedo property in 17.0, so this is a cleanup for code that still uses them.
rules.advice: Core no longer has the undo methods or the undoRedo property. Call them on the plugin: hot.getPlugin('undoRedo').

In 17.x this called DOMPurify. In 18.0 it returns its input unchanged and is deprecated, so removing the call would drop the sanitization your code relies on. Pass a sanitizer through the sanitizer option, or call DOMPurify.sanitize() yourself.
